full_description: In the KitchenS bar scene, press and hold the beer tap button to pour into the beer mug under the spout. Flow runs while the button is held and stops when released. Foaminess of the stream rises the longer the button stays held and resets when released. Pause to settle foam, then release fully. Click the finish bell beside the tap to signal done — success or failure is scored on that press. Overflow fails.
